title: Sprint deadline moved
lines: Hi Emma, have you got a minute? I need to talk to you about the sprint deadline.
Sure, Mark. Is something wrong? You sound a bit worried.
Well, the payment team just told me their new API won't be ready until next Monday.
Oh no. We can't finish the checkout page without it, can we?
Not really. So I'd like to move our deadline from this Friday to next Thursday. That gives us three days to test.
That sounds reasonable. Have you told the client yet?
Not yet. I wanted to touch base with you first before we tell anyone.
OK. I'll send them an email this afternoon and explain the delay.
Great, thanks. And could you loop in the QA team too?
Sure. I'll copy them on the email so everyone's on the same page.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
o: A client has cancelled the project
Another team's API will be late
The checkout page has a bug
The QA team is too busy
questions.vi: Người đàn ông nói "their new API won't be ready until next Monday" – API của nhóm khác bị trễ. Bẫy: "checkout page" có xuất hiện nhưng không phải bị lỗi.

questions.q: When is the new deadline?
questions.vi: "move our deadline from this Friday to next Thursday". Bẫy: Friday là hạn cũ, Monday là ngày API xong.

questions.q: What does the woman say she will do this afternoon?
questions.vi: "I'll send them an email this afternoon" – "them" là khách hàng (the client).

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.vi: "could you loop in the QA team" – loop in = đưa ai vào cuộc trao đổi, tức là include.

title: Critical bug before release
title_vi: Lỗi nghiêm trọng trước ngày phát hành
lines: Hey Daniel, got a sec? QA just found a critical bug in the login flow.
Seriously? The release is tomorrow morning at nine.
I know. Users with two-factor authentication can't sign in at all. That's roughly fifteen percent of our customers.
That's a big chunk. Who's the best person to fix it?
Priya wrote that module, but she's on leave until Thursday.
Hmm. What about Tom? He reviewed her code last month.
He could, but he's already flat out with the database migration.
OK, I'll take it myself, then. If it's a simple fix, I should have it done by tonight.
Then we'll push the release to Friday. I'll give the product manager a heads-up just in case.
Good idea. I'll ask QA to stay a bit later to retest.

questions.q: What problem does the woman report?
o: Some users are unable to log in
questions.vi: "Users with two-factor authentication can't sign in at all" = không đăng nhập được. Bẫy: "database migration" là việc của Tom, không phải sự cố.

questions.q: Why can't Priya fix the bug?
o: She is busy with a migration
She is not familiar with the code
questions.vi: "she's on leave until Thursday" = đang nghỉ phép. Bẫy: bận migration là Tom, không phải Priya.

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "he's already flat out with the database migration"?
o: Tom has no time to help
Tom needs help with the database
questions.vi: "flat out" = cực kỳ bận, nên Tom không có thời gian giúp sửa lỗi.

questions.q: According to the man, what will happen if the fix is not simple?
o: Tom will take over the fix
The release will move to Friday
questions.vi: "Then we'll push the release to Friday" – push = dời lại. Bẫy: Thursday là ngày Priya quay lại.

title: Client change request
title_vi: Yêu cầu thay đổi từ khách hàng
lines: Oliver, Northwind just sent a change request. They want the dashboard to export to PDF as well as Excel.
At this stage? We're only two weeks from handover.
I know. I've had a rough look, and I think it's about forty extra hours of work.
Forty hours at our standard rate is, what, around six thousand dollars?
Right. But they've mentioned the budget's tight, so they might push back.
Well, we could offer the PDF export as a phase-two item. That way the handover date stays on the fifteenth.
That's an option. Or we deliver everything on the twenty-ninth, if they're willing to pay the full amount.
Let's give them both and let them choose. Can you put together a short estimate?
Sure. I'll have it ready by tomorrow noon. Should I copy in their project manager?
Yes, please. And I'll set up a call with them on Thursday to walk through it.

questions.q: What does the client want?
o: Another export option in the dashboard
questions.vi: "export to PDF as well as Excel" được diễn đạt lại thành "another export option". Bẫy: "budget", "hours" có trong bài nhưng không phải yêu cầu.

questions.q: How much would the change cost?
questions.vi: "around six thousand dollars". Bẫy: forty (giờ công) và fifteen (ngày bàn giao) là số gây nhiễu.

questions.q: What does the man suggest?
o: Moving the handover to the twenty-ninth
Asking the client for more budget
Delivering one feature at a later stage
questions.vi: "offer the PDF export as a phase-two item" = giao tính năng ở giai đoạn sau. Bẫy: ngày 29 là đề xuất của người phụ nữ.

questions.q: What will the woman do by tomorrow noon?
o: Hold a call with the client
questions.vi: "put together a short estimate" – "I'll have it ready by tomorrow noon". Bẫy: cuộc gọi thứ Năm là việc của người đàn ông.

title: Booking a workshop room
lines: Hi, this is Sarah from Marketing. I'd like to book a meeting room for a workshop next Tuesday.
Sure. Is it a full day or a half day?
Just the morning, from nine to one. There'll be about twenty people.
OK, let me check. Room 5B holds twenty-five, and it's free that morning. It's on the fifth floor, right next to the lifts.
Perfect. Does it have a projector?
Yes, it does. But the microphone in that room isn't working right now.
Oh. Could we borrow a portable one?
Sure, I can bring one up from the IT office on Monday afternoon.
That'd be great. Also, we'll need two flip charts.
No problem, there are a couple in the storage room. I'll send you a confirmation email in a few minutes, and just let me know if anything changes.

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?
questions.vi: "I'd like to book a meeting room" – book = reserve.

questions.q: How many people will attend the workshop?
questions.vi: "There'll be about twenty people". Bẫy: 25 là sức chứa phòng, 9 là giờ bắt đầu.

questions.q: What problem does the man mention?
questions.vi: "the microphone in that room isn't working" = micro bị hỏng.

questions.q: What does the man offer to do on Monday?
questions.vi: "I can bring one up from the IT office on Monday afternoon" – "one" = portable microphone.

title: Supplier shipment delayed
title_vi: Lô hàng nhà cung cấp bị trễ
lines: Thanks for joining, both of you. Bad news: the circuit boards from our supplier in Shenzhen are stuck at the port.
How long is the delay, James?
They're saying ten days, maybe longer, because of a customs inspection.
That's going to hit our production line. We've only got enough stock for about a week.
Could we ship part of the order by air instead?
We could, but air freight would cost an extra four thousand dollars.
Honestly, that's peanuts compared to shutting down the line.
Agreed. There's also a distributor in Singapore that keeps some of these boards in stock.
Good thinking, Lucy. Could you contact them today and ask about prices?
Sure, I'll call them after lunch.
And I'll let the production manager know what's going on, so he can plan around it.

questions.q: Why is the shipment delayed?
o: The supplier ran out of stock
The goods are being checked by customs
questions.vi: "because of a customs inspection" = hải quan đang kiểm tra hàng.

questions.q: How long will the company's current stock last?
questions.vi: "enough stock for about a week". Bẫy: ten days là thời gian trễ hàng.

questions.q: What does one of the men mean when he says, "that's peanuts compared to shutting down the line"?
o: The extra cost is worth paying
The line should stop for a while
The supplier should pay the cost
questions.vi: "peanuts" = số tiền rất nhỏ; 4.000 đô vẫn đáng trả hơn là dừng dây chuyền.

questions.q: What will the woman do this afternoon?
questions.vi: Lucy nói "I'll call them after lunch" – "them" là nhà phân phối ở Singapore. Bẫy: báo production manager là việc của người đàn ông kia.

title: Onboarding a new hire
title_vi: Chuẩn bị cho nhân viên mới
lines: Hi Kevin, it's Rachel from HR. Our new back-end developer, Minh, starts on Monday the third.
Right, she's on my list. Her laptop arrived yesterday, but I still need to install the dev tools.
Will it be ready in time?
Should be. I'll finish it by Friday afternoon. Her email's already active, but I can't open up repository access until her manager approves it.
That'd be Alan. He's at a conference until Wednesday, though.
Then she won't be able to touch the code for her first two days.
Not ideal. Could his deputy, Joanna, sign it off instead?
Yes, any team lead can approve it. I'll send Joanna the request now.
Security only prints badges at the start of the week, so she'll collect it from the front desk at ten on her first day.
Fine. I'll mention that in her welcome email.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
o: Preparing for a new employee's arrival
questions.vi: Cả bài nói về laptop, tài khoản, thẻ ra vào cho Minh, người "starts on Monday the third". Bẫy: "conference" là nơi Alan đang đi.

questions.q: Why can't the man set up repository access yet?
questions.vi: "can't open up repository access until her manager approves it" = cần quản lý phê duyệt. Bẫy: laptop đã đến, email đã hoạt động.

questions.q: What will the man probably do next?
questions.vi: "I'll send Joanna the request now" – "now" = việc làm ngay. Bẫy: cài dev tools thì đến thứ Sáu mới xong.

questions.q: When will the new employee receive her badge?
questions.vi: "at ten on her first day" – ngày đầu là Monday the third, nên là sáng thứ Hai. Đây là câu suy luận kết hợp hai chi tiết.

title: Rescheduling a client demo
title_vi: Dời lịch demo cho khách hàng
lines: Hi Jessica. The client in Chicago just emailed. They can't make the demo on Thursday.
Oh, really? That's a shame, we were all set. Did they say why?
Their CEO wants to join, but she's traveling that day.
OK, that makes sense. So when can they do it instead?
They suggested Friday at eight a.m., Chicago time.
Hmm, that's nine p.m. for us. A bit late, but I can manage if it's only an hour.
Me too. I'll send them a new calendar invite, then, and confirm the time on both sides.
Great. Should we do a quick test run before the demo?
Good idea. How about Friday afternoon at two?
Works for me. I'll book a room and let the team know. We should also double-check that the demo data is up to date.

questions.q: Why is the demo being rescheduled?
questions.vi: "Their CEO ... she's traveling that day" – CEO được diễn đạt lại là "client executive".

questions.q: What time will the demo start for the speakers?
questions.vi: "that's nine p.m. for us". Bẫy: 8 a.m. là giờ Chicago, 2 p.m. là buổi chạy thử.

questions.q: What will the man do?
questions.vi: "I'll send them a new calendar invite". Bẫy: đặt phòng là việc của người phụ nữ.

questions.q: What does the woman suggest?
questions.vi: "do a quick test run before the demo" = buổi tập/chạy thử (practice session).

title: Expense report rejected
title_vi: Báo cáo chi phí bị từ chối
lines: Hi, Peter? It's Nina from Finance. I'm calling about your expense report for the Singapore trip.
Oh, hi Nina. Is there a problem?
I'm afraid it's been rejected. Two receipts are missing: the taxi from the airport and one hotel dinner.
Ah, the taxi driver didn't give me one. But I should have the dinner receipt somewhere.
OK. For the taxi, you can fill in a missing-receipt form, as long as it's under fifty dollars.
It was about thirty-five, so that's fine.
Great. Just send everything back to me by Wednesday.
And when would I get paid?
If I get it by then, the money will go out with payroll on the twenty-fifth.
That's a relief. Things are a bit tight this month.
I understand. I'll keep an eye out for your email.

questions.q: Why was the man's report rejected?
questions.vi: "Two receipts are missing" – thiếu hóa đơn.

questions.q: What can the man do about the taxi expense?
o: Ask the driver for a copy
questions.vi: "you can fill in a missing-receipt form" = điền mẫu đơn thay cho hóa đơn. Bẫy: "driver" có trong bài nhưng tài xế không đưa hóa đơn.

questions.q: When will the man be reimbursed?
questions.vi: "the money will go out with payroll on the twenty-fifth". Bẫy: Wednesday là hạn nộp lại giấy tờ.

questions.q: What does the man mean when he says, "Things are a bit tight this month"?
questions.vi: "tight" ở đây nói về tiền bạc = đang eo hẹp tài chính, nên anh ấy mừng vì sắp được hoàn tiền.

title: Anniversary catering
title_vi: Đặt tiệc kỷ niệm công ty
lines: Hi, I'm calling from Brightline Software. We're celebrating our tenth anniversary on the twelfth of June, and we need catering.
Congratulations! How many guests are you expecting?
We've invited a hundred and fifty, but we're planning for about a hundred and twenty.
OK. Our buffet package is thirty-two dollars a head, and that includes drinks.
Does it cover vegetarian options? About a third of our staff don't eat meat.
Yes, and we can do vegan and gluten-free on request at no extra charge.
Great. What about a cake? I'd like one with our logo on it.
We can do that, but custom cakes need two weeks' notice, so we'd need the design by the twenty-ninth of May.
That's cutting it close. Our designer's away until the twenty-fifth.
That still leaves a few days. I'll email you a quote today, and a twenty percent deposit will lock in the date.

questions.q: What is the company celebrating?
questions.vi: "our tenth anniversary" = kỷ niệm 10 năm, diễn đạt lại thành "business milestone".

questions.q: How many people does the man expect to attend?
o: About a third of the staff
questions.vi: "invited a hundred and fifty, but we're planning for about a hundred and twenty". Bẫy: 150 là số người được mời, 32 là giá mỗi suất.

questions.q: What does the woman say about special diets?
o: They must be ordered by the 25th
They are available at no charge
questions.vi: "vegan and gluten-free on request at no extra charge" = miễn phí. Bẫy: "two weeks' notice" là cho bánh kem.

questions.q: What will the woman probably do next?
questions.vi: "I'll email you a quote today". Bẫy: deposit là việc khách phải làm sau đó, không phải việc tiếp theo của cô ấy.

title: Server outage review
title_vi: Họp rút kinh nghiệm sự cố máy chủ
lines: OK, let's keep this short, we've all got a lot on today. Ben, can you walk us through what happened last night?
Sure. The main web server went down at about eleven fifteen and was offline for forty minutes.
The disk got full. The old log files weren't being deleted, so they just kept growing.
And how did we find out?
A customer emailed support. Our monitoring didn't send any alert.
That's not good. We should've known before the customers did. That's the bigger issue here.
Agreed. So, two actions. Ben, can you set up automatic log cleanup?
Sure, I'll have it done by Wednesday and test it on the staging server first.
And Claire, could you add a disk space alert to our monitoring?
Leave it with me. I'll do it today.

questions.q: How long was the server offline?
questions.vi: "offline for forty minutes". Bẫy: "eleven fifteen" là thời điểm sập.

questions.q: What caused the problem?
o: Log files filled up the disk
questions.vi: "The disk got full. The old log files weren't being deleted" – log đầy ổ đĩa.

questions.q: How did the team learn about the outage?
questions.vi: "A customer emailed support". Bẫy: monitoring KHÔNG gửi cảnh báo.

questions.q: What does Claire mean when she says, "Leave it with me"?
o: She wants to leave the meeting
questions.vi: "Leave it with me" = để tôi lo việc đó; cô ấy nhận làm cảnh báo dung lượng đĩa ngay hôm nay.

title: Interview panel scheduling
title_vi: Sắp xếp hội đồng phỏng vấn
lines: Hi Laura. I'm putting together the interview panel for the senior developer role. Have you got a moment?
Sure, Greg. Who's on it so far?
Me, Hannah from the architecture team, and I'd like you to join as well.
Happy to. When are the interviews?
We've got three candidates. I was thinking Tuesday the eighth, all afternoon.
Ah, I've got a client workshop that day. Could we do Wednesday the ninth instead?
Let me check Hannah's calendar. She's free on the ninth, but only until three.
So if each interview's an hour, we'd need to start at noon.
That works. I'll book a room and send invites to the candidates today.
Great. Could you also forward me their CVs? I'd like to prepare some technical questions.
Will do. I'll send them over by the end of the day.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.vi: "putting together the interview panel for the senior developer role" – sắp xếp phỏng vấn. Bẫy: "architecture team", "client workshop" chỉ là chi tiết phụ.

questions.q: Why can't the woman attend on Tuesday?
questions.vi: "I've got a client workshop that day".

questions.q: What time will the interviews probably start?
questions.vi: "we'd need to start at noon" – ba buổi mỗi buổi 1 tiếng, kết thúc trước 3 giờ. Bẫy: three là giờ Hannah bận, nine là ngày 9.

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.vi: "forward me their CVs" – CV = résumé. Bẫy: chuẩn bị câu hỏi là việc cô ấy tự làm.

title: Moving to a new floor
lines: Hi Mike. Facilities just confirmed our move to the sixth floor. It's happening the weekend of the twentieth.
Finally. Do we know the seating plan yet?
Roughly. The dev team gets the area by the windows, and QA's going next to the kitchen.
QA won't be thrilled about that. How many desks are there?
Forty-two, which is four more than we need, so we've got some room to grow.
Good. What about network ports? Last time, half of them didn't work.
IT's testing every port on the Thursday before, the eighteenth.
And the printer? We've only got the one on four.
They're moving it up, but it won't be connected until Monday at eleven. So anyone who needs printouts for Monday morning should print them on Friday.
Got it. I'll put that in my team update right away.
Thanks. Oh, and packing crates arrive Wednesday; everything has to be labelled by Friday at five.

questions.q: When will the office move take place?
questions.vi: "It's happening the weekend of the twentieth". Bẫy: 18 là ngày kiểm tra cổng mạng, Wednesday là ngày thùng đến.

questions.q: What does the man mean when he says, "QA won't be thrilled about that"?
o: QA asked to sit by the windows
QA will likely be unhappy with their spot
questions.vi: "won't be thrilled" = sẽ không vui; QA bị xếp ngồi cạnh bếp.

questions.q: What problem did the man experience during a previous move?
questions.vi: "Last time, half of them didn't work" – "them" = network ports. Bẫy: bàn hiện thừa 4 chỗ, không thiếu.

questions.q: What will the man probably do next?
o: Tell his team about the printing arrangements
questions.vi: "I'll put that in my team update right away" – "that" = lời khuyên in tài liệu trước vào thứ Sáu. Bẫy: test cổng mạng là việc của IT.

title: Volume discount
title_vi: Thương lượng chiết khấu số lượng
lines: Hi Fiona, thanks for taking my call. We're planning to order more monitors this quarter.
Great to hear, Tom. How many are you thinking?
About two hundred. Your price is a hundred and eighty dollars each. Can you offer a discount for that volume?
For two hundred units, I can give you eight percent off.
Hmm. To be honest, another supplier offered us ten percent for the same order.
I see. If you order two hundred and fifty, I can match that.
That's more than we need right now, and we don't have the storage space. Could you include free delivery instead?
OK. Eight percent plus free delivery. Deal?
That sounds fair. Can you send me the offer in writing?
Of course. I'll email it to you by tomorrow morning, and we can finalize it this week.

questions.q: What does the man want to buy?
questions.vi: "We're planning to order more monitors".

questions.q: How many items does the man plan to order?
questions.vi: "About two hundred". Bẫy: 180 là đơn giá, 250 là số lượng để được giảm 10%.

questions.q: What do the speakers agree on?
o: Eight percent off with free delivery
questions.vi: "Eight percent plus free delivery. Deal?" – "That sounds fair." Bẫy: 10% chỉ có khi đặt 250 chiếc.

questions.q: What will the woman do by tomorrow morning?
questions.vi: "send me the offer in writing" – "I'll email it to you by tomorrow morning".

title: Code review compromise
lines: So, Sophie, about your pull request. I left a comment asking you to split the payment service into three smaller classes.
Yeah, I saw it, Jake. Honestly, I think that's overkill for now. The class is only about three hundred lines.
But it's going to grow. We're adding refunds next sprint.
Can I jump in? I think you both have a point.
Sophie, what if you merge it as it is, but put the refund logic in its own class when we build it?
I can live with that. It means I don't have to redo the tests before Friday's release.
OK, fine by me, as long as we add a ticket so it doesn't get forgotten.
Fair enough. Jake, can you create the ticket?
Sure, I'll do it right after this call and put it in next sprint.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
o: How to fix a payment bug
questions.vi: Tranh luận về việc "split the payment service into three smaller classes" – cách tổ chức code. Bẫy: "release", "tests" chỉ là chi tiết phụ.

questions.q: Why does Jake want Sophie to change her code?
o: The code has too many bugs
The class will get bigger soon
questions.vi: "it's going to grow. We're adding refunds next sprint" = class sẽ to ra.

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "I can live with that"?
o: She is unhappy with the plan
She wants to rewrite the tests
questions.vi: "I can live with that" = tôi chấp nhận được, đồng ý với đề xuất của David.

questions.q: What will Jake do after the call?
o: Create a task for next sprint
questions.vi: "I'll do it right after this call and put it in next sprint" – "it" = ticket, diễn đạt lại thành "task". Bẫy: tách class đã bị hoãn.

title: Changing flights
lines: Hi, Liam. Bad news: the Tokyo client just moved our meeting from Thursday to Friday afternoon.
Oh, great. Our return flight's on Friday at six p.m.
Exactly. The meeting runs from two to five, so there's no way we'll make it to the airport.
Right. Let me check the airline's site. There's one at ten on Saturday morning, or one at eleven-forty Friday night.
And when does the late one get in?
Seven on Saturday morning. Either way, the change fee is a hundred and twenty dollars each.
I'd rather skip the red-eye. Could we stay one more night at the hotel?
I'll check. Our hotel has rooms at a hundred and fifty a night.
That's fine. Can you rebook the flights, and I'll extend the hotel?
Sure. I'll also give Finance a heads-up about the extra cost.

questions.q: Why do the speakers need to change their plans?
questions.vi: "the Tokyo client just moved our meeting from Thursday to Friday afternoon" – cuộc họp bị dời.

questions.q: How much is the fee for changing each ticket?
questions.vi: "the change fee is a hundred and twenty dollars each". Bẫy: 150 là giá phòng khách sạn mỗi đêm.

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'd rather skip the red-eye"?
o: She doesn't want an overnight flight
She wants to cancel the meeting
questions.vi: "red-eye" = chuyến bay đêm (chuyến 11:40 tối thứ Sáu); cô ấy muốn bay sáng thứ Bảy và ở thêm một đêm.

questions.q: What will the woman do?
questions.vi: "I'll extend the hotel". Bẫy: đổi vé và báo Finance là việc của Liam.
